phase_graph.prepull: Controller summons four inactive constructs (Inactive 78726, Powered Down 82265, not selectable); 10 s after reset the first queued construct recharges (45 s normal) and then walks its patrol, attackable, without Activated.
phase_graph.engage: Any construct entering combat: IN_PROGRESS, all constructs zone into combat, the patrolling construct receives Activated (90 s normal) and the next construct starts Recharging.
phase_graph.rotation: Every 45 s (normal) the next construct activates; each active construct shields once 50 s after activation (1.5 s cast, 10 s aura) and shuts down at 90 s (Shutting Down 3 s cast, then Inactive). Two constructs overlap except during the first 45 s.
phase_graph.end: Shared health reaches zero: every construct dies, the controller calls _JustDied (boss 1 DONE); credit creature 42180.
phase_graph.wipe: A construct evading despawns all constructs, sets FAIL and respawns the controller after 30 s.

tanks: two tanks own at most one active construct each; ownership follows the construct's victim, a new construct goes to the tank whose construct is gone or shutting down

taunt an owned construct that attacks anyone else (a single-cast allowance when it is shielded; a taunt deals no damage, so it procs no shield effect once the staged spell_proc 79729 row is promoted (before that, one Converted Power stack on Arcanotron under Power Conversion))
stop attacking an owned construct while it is shielded and drag it 12 yd from the other active construct

hold an owned unshielded construct on its centre slot: two slots 5 yd west and east of the arena centre (-324.78, -399.08), paired by the smaller total walk and moved out of a Power Generator's reach; walk 3.5 yd past the slot when the construct is more than 6 yd from it; never into a hazard
walk an owned construct out of a Power Generator (construct center >= 8.6 yd from it)
a free tank waits next to the construct whose Recharging aura ends within 12 s
interrupt: interrupt every Arcane Annihilator (79710) with a rotation by capability: in-range melee 10 s interrupts, then ranged, then tanks, then long cooldowns; a backup acts 450 ms into the cast; under Power Conversion the interrupt still lands; a non-damaging interrupt gives no Converted Power on 10N (WCL round 3; staged spell_proc 79729 SpellTypeMask 1, before which native gave one stack); the restriction is widened for that single cast only; a member whose recorded interrupt is still on its client cooldown from an earlier cast is passed over for the turn (the backup covers only a primary that fails)
dispel: poison dispellers (Cleanse 4987, Remove Corruption 2782; not a Bear Form tank) clear Soaked In Poison at 3+ stacks or below 50% health
ranged: kill Poison Bombs, the living one nearest its fixate target first, wherever it stands: a killed bomb despawns without the 80092 blast (native JustDied; WCL 10N poison_bomb_death); only its melee contact with the target explodes
stand in the Power Generator when it is clear of hazards
raid: damage an active construct whose shield is spent this activation, else the newest active unshielded one; never damage a shielded or shield-casting construct (every construct entry is restricted per bot and only unshielded active constructs are allowed)
Lightning Conductor carrier keeps more than 8 yd from everyone; others keep out of its 8 yd
Acquiring Target player leads the Flamethrower cone away; everyone else leaves the 25 degree Magmatron-to-target cone
fixated player kites its Poison Bomb away from everyone
leave Chemical Cloud (12 yd), Poison Puddle (6 yd) and other players' bomb blast radius (6 yd)
healers: keep every living tank within 30 yd (heal range 40 yd): with a tank farther away, walk to the nearest clear point around the tanks' centroid that reaches every tank (outside hazards and a Lightning Conductor carrier's reach)
stand in a Power Generator only when it is within 30 yd of every living tank

bot_strategy.offense_authority: BotOmnotronOffenseAuthority.h: per bot, all four construct entries are restricted and only the plan's active unshielded constructs are allowed (direct casts refused, area spells refused beside a restricted construct); interrupts and taunts on a shielded construct run under a SingleCastAllowance that is restored right after the cast.
bot_strategy.damage_focus: A construct whose one shield of this activation was observed and has ended (BotOmnotronShieldLedger.h) is preferred; else the newest active unshielded construct. At steady state a construct receives no damage from ~16 s after activation until its shield ends, so DoTs (up to 21 s) expire before the shield; only the opening construct carries fresh DoTs into its shield.

unresolved.evidence_gap: 10N resolved 2026-09-30 by user decision (source user_decision_20260930_omnotron_barrier_absorb_10n): "Accept 300,000 (Recommended)". Client row 300,000 (4.4.2.59185; native already uses it); WCL lower bound 267,864 (MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ-24). Evidence behind the decision: no Barrier has broken in any WCL 10N kill read (21 kills over rounds 2-3). Round 3 (source wcl_omnotron_10n_r3_20260930) read the ten tier-11 references: five Barrier windows absorbed 159,220 (mfnZAdFTLkjMBC3z-6, full 10 s), 172,072 (Z36FdRPNbAgjrqGX-13, 4.0 s, kill), 111,283 (VvXJBz2A93FRY4xm-15), 232,754 (MRytXdWJxkBpfPK1-26) and 267,864 (MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ-24), none broke and no Backdraft 79617 row exists; the other five kills had no Barrier window (Magmatron's shield fell outside the kill). The WCL lower bound is consistent with the client 300,000 and the Wowhead 900,000 alike; raids stop damage on Magmatron during Barrier, so a break is rare and the bots never damage a shielded construct (acceptance: Backdraft 0). Open for 10H, 25N and 25H: heroic client 150,000 vs Wowhead 450,000, no same-mode sample.

Resolved for 10N (source wcl_omnotron_10n_r3_20260930): qaKLyFTxkvc9hVpM fight 11, Unstable Shield 01:35.768-01:45.782: the ranged Survival hunter Minimaz was hit alone four times (01:40.034, 01:40.310, 01:42.694, 01:45.033), each 0.5-0.9 s after his own Auto Shot or Cobra Shot on Electron, while the Protection paladin tank Bûggers and four melee next to Electron were not hit; the Frost mage Smf was hit alone at 01:38.505, 1.0 s after her Frostbolt. Melee-triggered bursts (01:38.171: tank plus four melee, 195 ms after the tank's Hammer of the Righteous) land 0.2-0.3 s after the hit. A construct-centred 6 yd blast would hit the tank each time, so the blast is centred on the attacker (Wowhead tooltip 'at a nearby enemy's location', client 79912 TARGET_DEST_TARGET_ENEMY, native cast at the attacker); the Wowhead text 'within 6 yards of the boss' is wrong. Pet and totem hits (Zeke, Searing Totem) never triggered one. Open for 10H/25N/25H: no same-mode sample.

Resolved for 10N (source wcl_omnotron_10n_r3_20260930): a landed interrupt without damage gives no Converted Power 79735. Clean samples: qaKLyFTxkvc9hVpM-11 Wind Shear 00:55.765 (1,307 ms after the previous gain, next gain 00:58.318), Z36FdRPNbAgjrqGX-13 Rebuke 01:38.392 (1.27 s into Power Conversion, first gain 01:41.415), VvXJBz2A93FRY4xm-15 Mind Freeze 00:54.072 (1.03 s into Power Conversion, no direct hit within 600 ms, first gain 00:55.936). The Mind Freeze gains in TaAF1ncP89KgpbLx-12 (02:25.695) and mfnZAdFTLkjMBC3z-6 (01:44.686) share the millisecond with the Death Knight's own melee hit; the w2W84MtybL1VKCvQ-12 gain after Wind Shear coincides with a Smite hit. Native (spell_proc 79729 SpellTypeMask 0) gave one stack per interrupt; sql/custom/world/2026_09_30_30_omnotron_defense_system_power_conversion_proc.sql (promoted 2026-09-30) sets SpellTypeMask 1 for 79729. No taunt landed on Arcanotron under Power Conversion; a taunt is a no-damage spell hit on the same proc path, so the staged row covers it too (live check: Converted Power stacks per taunt = 0). Open for 10H/25N/25H (91543-91545 unchanged): no same-mode sample.
Heroic only: Lord Victor Nefarius upgrade order and cadence (guide about every 35 s vs the local 30 s cooldown); needs a heroic WCL kill.
Heroic Poison Bombs per tick (client one vs Wowhead two) and the 25N/10H/25H health and damage values rest on client rows and guides only; no same-mode WCL kill.
